SeqConnector R6 class

Source: R/seq_connector.R
SeqConnectorR6.Rd

Internal R6 generator backing seq_connector(). Inherits from SeqLinkR6. Draws a cubic Bezier from one edge of an interval to one edge of another, on the same or different tracks.

Super classes

SeqElement -> SeqLink -> SeqConnector

Public fields

styles

Named list of list(col, lty, lwd) keyed by style.

height

Block height as a fraction of the panel inner height.

handle

Handle length as a fraction of the track inner width.

bulge_height

Same-track bulge as a fraction of the panel inner height.

SeqConnector$new()

Construct a SeqConnectorR6.

Usage

SeqConnector$new(
  data = NULL,
  mapping = NULL,
  t0 = NULL,
  t1 = NULL,
  aesthetics = aes(),
  styles = NULL,
  height = 0.5,
  handle = 0.04,
  bulge_height = 0.45,
  layer = c("above", "below"),
  legend = NULL,
  show_legend = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

data

Optional GRanges or data.frame.

mapping

Optional SeqMap.

t0, t1

aesthetics

Optional SeqAes.

Optional named list of list(col, lty, lwd).

Geometry fractions.

layer

"above" or "below".

legend

Optional legend.

show_legend

Logical.

...

Reserved.

SeqConnector$prep()

Resolve both anchors, map the chosen edges to canvas npc and store four Bezier control points per connector in self$coordCanvas.

Usage

SeqConnector$prep(
  layout_all_tracks,
  track_windows_list,
  plot_track_index = NULL
)

Arguments

layout_all_tracks

Named list of per-track panel-bounds lists.

track_windows_list

Named list of per-track GRanges windows.

plot_track_index

Fallback track reference.
